name: github-pr-merge
tagline_zh: 合并PR前自动跑测试、lint和CI，还检查评论是否吵完。你点头才合，合完顺手清理分支，少背锅。
tagline_en: Auto-checks tests, lint, CI, and review comments before merging. You confirm, it merges, then cleans up. No more.
desc_en: Merges GitHub Pull Requests after validating pre-merge checklist. Use when user wants to merge PR, close PR, finalize PR, complete merge, approve and merge, or execute merge. Runs pre-merge validation (tests, lint, CI, comments), confirms with user, merges with proper format, handles post-merge cleanup.
why_zh: 同类工具只合代码，它把「合并前检查清单」变成硬门槛，还替你处理合并后清理，省心且防翻车。
why_en: Unlike simple merge tools, it enforces a pre-merge checklist and handles post-merge cleanup, turning risky merges into safe.
